srList.sentence: To evaluate demographic similarity between groups, participant characteristics were compared between groups utilizing either a two-tailed student T test for continuous variables with two groups, an ANOVA omnibus for continuous variables with more than two groups (with Tukey HSD post-hoc tests for paired compairsons), or an extended exact Fisher omnibus for percentages with more than two groups (with Fisher exact tests for paired comparisons).
